verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing says you can 'track spend instantly' against budgets (brex-docs-10), 'manage global spend and close the books in real time' (brex-docs-37), and 'view your spend' in the mobile app (brex-docs-21), and a transactions API exposes transactions, accounts and statements (brex-docs-4). This supports real-time spend visibility, but the evidence never shows dashboards or reports that break spend down by team, category or merchant; only a department filter on the users API hints at team grouping (brex-docs-19). Missing for 10: documented spend breakdowns by team, category and merchant, evidence of same-day transaction posting latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
